key_statements: I believe in one God, the Father, the Almighty, maker of heaven and earth, and of all things visible and invisible.
And in one Lord Jesus Christ, the only begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all worlds.
I believe in God, the Father almighty, maker of heaven and earth, and of all things visible and invisible.
And in Jesus Christ, his only begotten Son, our Lord.
I believe in one God, the Father Almighty, maker of heaven and earth, and of all things visible and invisible.
And in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son of God, begotten of the Father before all worlds.

historical_debates.catholic_position: The addition of 'and the Son' (Filioque) to the Nicene Creed is necessary for the full expression of the Trinity.
historical_debates.orthodox_position: The Filioque is a later addition and not part of the original Nicene Creed.

historical_debates.calvinist_position: Predestination is the doctrine that God has foreordained the salvation or damnation of all men from eternity.
historical_debates.augustinian_position: Predestination is the foreknowledge of God concerning the eternal purpose and destiny of men.
